name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 13 – Am 51
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 13a. Strongly opposes the introduction of new own resources; believes that, at a time of rising prices and declining purchasing power, new taxes must not be imposed on citizens and businesses;
